steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Back already, Gulo? You still have the gauze on your head.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I told you to think before you act! You get back to the hospital right now and stay in bed.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Master... I heard that you're going to meet with Ratatos again, at the Browntails' invitation.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: You can't go...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What, you think I'm afraid of her?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That witch says she's going to tell me the truth. I'm eager to see what she spews from that mouth of hers.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But master... the meeting is on Browntail turf. This is clearly a trap.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hmph, you think I don't know?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: A Paleroche never runs from a fight!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Just because it's her turf doesn't mean a Paleroche is helpless there!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You know what? Seeing that gauze on your head is making me doubly-mad!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: I don't care how mad you are, master! I'm sitting right here at the door and not budging an inch until you change your mind!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: And what does any of that have to do with you?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: It's my own fault I got hurt and couldn't protect you. All I can do is stop you from putting yourself in danger.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Uh... I'm not angry at you! I'm angry at those bloody Browntails.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll settle the score for you. I'll show them nobody messes with Clan Paleroche.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Get out of the way, brother.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Master...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Warriors, take General Gulo back to his room.
Several warriors help Gulo up and help him walk back to his room.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'm not afraid of them. But I won't go unprepared.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Fy faen. Prepare a few more cars, boys.

spans.text: . Prepare a few more cars, boys.

steps.name: Browntail Butler
steps.text: Dinner is ready, Madam Sciurus.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What about the matriarch? Will she not join us?

steps.name: Browntail Butler
steps.text: Matriarch Ratatos just left. She says not to worry about her.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: I remember the matriarch saying she had a meeting with Clan Paleroche today. But it's so early...

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Did she go alone?

steps.name: Browntail Butler
steps.text: We're not sure...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Something doesn't feel right, Yucatan.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Go after her.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Browntail Butler
steps.text: One moment, please, Madam Sciurus and Master Yucatan...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What is it this time?

steps.name: Browntail Butler
steps.text: The matriarch left orders before she left...

steps.name: Browntail Butler
steps.text: We are not to allow the two of you to leave home tonight.

steps.name: Browntail Butler
steps.text: Under any circumstances.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Saintess! Get down!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Drat... Who are these people?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: How dare they attempt to murder the Saintess on Kjerag soil?!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Maybe they're not from Kjerag...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: They're dangerous...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Don't worry, Saintess! I'll protect you with my life!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: They won't get in so easily... Don't underestimate the hunters of Kjerag!
The young huntress locks and loads her heavy crossbow, barely taking any time to aim it through the broken window before pulling the trigger.
It is immediately followed by multiple screams.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Hit.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Careful, there are a lot of them!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: We can't just stay here. We need to get out...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: What do we do—

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Calm down. Listen to me...
Lying prone on the snow, the attacker gestures to those behind him to remain hidden. They learned their lesson the hard way.
They slowly close in on the house, on guard against the crossbow bolts that can be fired from the window at any time with uncanny accuracy.
They could see a shadow move behind the curtain, and the edges of the curtain sway...
The attacker raises his crossbow.
The poisoned bolt strikes the figure behind the curtain. He hears the sound of the body hitting the floor, then silence.

steps.name: Attacker
steps.text: Hit. Not sure if she's down.

steps.name: Attacker
steps.text: Units Two, Three and Four, hold position. Unit One, with me. Approach with care. The intel says there are two of them.
Several figures sneak up to the house, breaking in once they have determined no sound coming from inside.

steps.name: Attacker
steps.text: What...? This... It's...

steps.name: Attacker
steps.text: ...A wooden sculpture?
A sculpture of Kjeragandr lies on the ground, a crossbow bolt sticking out of its head.
The assailants did not notice the delicate sound of machinery operating as they entered the room.
They hear the ringing of a bell, while their arms and legs go weak.
Five loaded crossbows and a massive net take aim at the invaders.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: They fell for it! Just like you said!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: You'd better repent for damaging a sculpture of Kjeragandr!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Now! Run!

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: Alpha, report.

steps.name: Alpha
steps.text: The Paleroche convoy has cleared the third checkpoint.

steps.name: Alpha
steps.text: Confirm target position—back seat of the lead car.

steps.name: Alpha
steps.text: Shall we engage?

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: Affirmative.

steps.name: Alpha
steps.text: Wait, there's a change in the situation!

steps.name: Alpha
steps.text: The target's stopped moving. No direct line-of-sight. I can't see what's going on.

steps.name: Alpha
steps.text: Browntail warriors? What are they doing here?

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: Stand by. I'm calling Number One.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What's the meaning of this?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Your matriarch told us to come to meet her, then sent you to stop us?

steps.name: Browntail Guard
steps.text: The location of the meeting is just ahead, Sir Arctosz. This will only take a minute of your time.

steps.name: Browntail Guard
steps.text: Please allow us to search your vehicles, in the interest of safety.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What a joke. You're afraid of a handful of boys when your people picked the location? You people are cowards.

steps.name: Browntail Guard
steps.text: The orders came from Matriarch Ratatos. We request your cooperation.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hmph. Do what you want. I've got nothing to hide.

steps.name: Browntail Guard
steps.text: No issues. You may proceed now, Sir Arctosz.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Not so fast.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You searched us. Now, we search you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Search every nook and cranny from here to the Browntail manor, the road and everything around it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You find anybody suspicious, take them in!

steps.name: Paleroche Guard
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: Report on the target's location, Alpha.

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: Come in, Alpha.

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: Alpha, can you hear me? Report!

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: What's going on...?

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Command, the target car has entered our surveillance zone and is approaching the final point of action. Should we move?

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: When did he... is there any movement from the target?

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: No, the target hasn't exited the vehicle. I can't see inside from here.

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: Stand by. Engage once you have visual on the target.

steps.name: Bravo
steps.text: Bravo reporting.

steps.name: Bravo
steps.text: We have visual on what we believe to be an armed Kjerag patrol.

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: Have you identified them?

steps.name: Bravo
steps.text: Unclear, possibly Paleroche guards.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Charlie reporting! We've spotted Kjerag warriors too. They're searching nearby buildings.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Our position may be compromised. Should we make a move now?

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: Negative, stand by.

steps.name: Bravo
steps.text: We've been compromised! Engaging!

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: They found us! We've been exposed, repeat, we've been exposed!

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Permission for final action!

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: Bloody hell...

steps.name: Victorian Spy
steps.text: Affirmative—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: The north winds blow, over the mountain road...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: The tuskbeast hides, among the rocks he bides...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Take your bow, swing it low...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: ...By the little wood window.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Hit.
The forest is the domain of the hunter.
The young huntress takes Enya into the forest, the mysterious assailants in hot pursuit.
Their numbers are soon thinned by crossbow bolts that seem to come out of nowhere.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: There's at least one more... where are you...?
The huntress knows that her last shot has revealed her position, while the enemy has withdrawn into the shadows.
She hides behind a large tree, zeroing in on one little sound.
Lock, load, loose—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Missed?!
The young huntress is pushed to the ground as her shot misses.
The attacker picks up a bolt from the ground and aims it at her throat.
But he never gets the chance to bring his raised hand down. It is frozen.
A blurred silhouette appears from above the assailant, bringing the weight of a thousand mountains down upon his head.
The ground trembles, and the snow on the tree branches is scattered...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...Degenbrecher?
Degenbrecher catches the bolt flying towards her with one hand.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Who are you?! What do you want with the Saintess?!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Stop, Joanna! Degenbrecher is a friend.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Degenbrecher...?
Joanna hesitantly removes the bolt from her crossbow as she looks up and down at Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I've heard your name before... they say you're a strong warrior.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: But I've never seen... a man beaten into permafrost like that...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: What are you doing here, Degenbrecher?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Enciodes sent me.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I apologize, but now is not the time to stick to the rules.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: How did he know I was in danger...?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: This is not the only attack in recent days.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: There were attempts on the lives of the members of Clans Silverash and Paleroche, soon after you left the Vine-Bead Court. The three clans are on the brink of civil war.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: How could this be...?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: These people...
Only now do the trio have the time to take a long look at the assailants—late assailants, more precisely.
They are wearing Paleroche armor, and they are carrying standard-issue Kjerag weapons.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Clan Paleroche...?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: That's impossible!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Clan Paleroche has always been loyal. They would never think of murdering the Saintess!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But there has to be an explanation for these people.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Th-They must be in disguise! Someone is trying to frame the Paleroches!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Let me see... There must be some gap in their disguise...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Yes! Look at this bolt!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Hmph! These people thought they could fool us wearing Paleroche clothes, but they got a very important thing wrong.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Look, the bolts they're carrying are two-fletched, but the ones used by Paleroche warriors are three-fletched, which are more suitable for battle than hunting.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Dad told me that our family was the best, most loyal warriors of the Paleroches before we split from the clan.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Our shooting skills were passed down from our ancestors, who used them in war, mostly against—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: ...against the Silverashes.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: A logical explanation.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: All ancient history now.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The wars between the three clans, Paleroche, Browntail, and Silverash, have long since come to an end, and your family became hunters under Kjeragandr's kind guidance.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Yes... by Kjeragandr...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It's not hard to guess who is impersonating Clan Paleroche.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The Victorians...
Degenbrecher pulls a bolt from one of the Victorian's necks and examines it.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Did you make this yourself?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Yes, my dad taught me when I was little. The craftsmanship has been passed down my family from one generation to the next.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: From one generation to the next?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The cut of the fletching, the shape of the point, even the etching on the shaft, these are all unique to Ursus.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: How's that possible? Dad said it's a mark of Kjeragandr's faithful.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I've seen arrows like these in the arenas of Kazimierz many times, used by those who claimed to master the most authentic Ursine martial arts.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: A gimmick, no doubt, but the GCC also sponsors legitimate historians. I've read their papers and seen the artifacts they dug up.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: But... but we're all indigenous to Kjerag. We used to be part of Clan Paleroche!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: What does Ursus have to do with Kjerag?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: ...Enya?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: '...Some brought flags, some brought drums, and some brought swords.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'The three outsiders fought constantly, and their blood turned the rivers red, and She grieved.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'She went to the place of battle and said—'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'Sheathe your weapons and let your hearts be joined, and I will bestow upon you the blessings of prosperity, and protect you from ill.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'But the three were foolish, and continued to fight even after they heard Her words.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'So She cracked the heavens and split the clouds, and She brought forth a miracle, and the fighting was stopped.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'One of them wept: But how could we forget the hatred, the blood that was shed?'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'And She wept as well, and Her tears froze the enemy, becoming three eternally frozen peaks.'

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: ...What was that?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: A passage from the Kjeragandr that is often overlooked... now, I think I understand.

spans.text: that is often overlooked... now, I think I understand.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Joanna, I believe that your family... indeed, all of Clan Paleroche, originally came from Ursus.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: You think so too?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Yes. But it's not just you. The Silverashes and Browntails came from elsewhere as well.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: As the scriptures say, our three clans were outsiders who fought incessantly over resources, until Kjeragandr intervened.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The 'three frozen peaks' seem to refer literally to the three mountains surrounding Kjerag, but it in fact refers to the domains of the three clans, which She had demarcated.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'She will come again, if the swords are not laid down.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Several years ago, She manifested through me, averting what would have been the first civil war between the three clans in centuries.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The hearts of the three clans must be joined in order to receive Her protection...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The first virtue that Kjeragandr taught us was... forgiveness...

steps.name: Paleroche Guard
steps.text: We got them, master!
The tall guards bring over several prisoners, bound with ropes.

steps.name: Paleroche Guard
steps.text: These guys were hiding in some abandoned houses, clearly up to no good. They had binoculars and communications equipment on them. Victorians, by the looks of it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Ha. Just as I thought.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Ratatos is plotting with the Victorians to kill me. We'll take these men to her—

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: No, we'll do it in front of the Vine-Bead Court with all three clans present, and we'll see what she has to say for herself!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Who's there—

steps.name: Browntail Guard
steps.text: We caught the remaining Victorian spies, Sir Arctosz. We are glad to see that you are unharmed.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What? What do you mean?

steps.name: Browntail Guard
steps.text: Matriarch Ratatos's orders were to protect you, Sir Arctosz.

steps.name: Browntail Guard
steps.text: We had been following you, and stopped these men when they attempted to make a move against you.
The warriors put their bound prisoners down.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What in the name of Kjeragandr...?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: ...Where is Ratatos?

steps.name: Browntail Guard
steps.text: We do not know.

steps.name: Browntail Guard
steps.text: She said she would try to draw out the spies that Victoria has deployed around here. When they reveal themselves, we can—
The old Browntail manor explodes, its walls torn apart like cardboard.
Glass and wood fragments fly in all directions, as flames consume the traces of a once sumptuous history. The boiling smoke distorts the night air.
The Paleroche warriors stand transfixed, eyes wide. Behind the brown car, some warriors caught by the blast now stagger as they try to help each other up.
The echoes of the explosion gradually disperse, leaving the crackle of wood and distant sirens ever clearer in the night.
A charred jacket drifts down in front of Arctosz.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: ...Ratatos?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What the hell have you done?!
